events.description: A little turmeric, a lot of love. Join us for a beautiful Haldi ceremony filled with love, laughter and vibrant colours as we begin our wedding celebrations.

events.address: The Garden Pavilion, Palace Road, Civil Lines, Jaipur, Rajasthan - 302001
events.description: An evening of intricate henna, music and joy. Come adorned in greens as we celebrate love painted in the most beautiful patterns.

events.name: The Wedding
events.address: The Garden Pavilion, Palace Road, Civil Lines, Jaipur, Rajasthan - 302001
events.description: The moment we've been waiting for. Witness us exchange vows and begin our forever, surrounded by everyone we love.

events.name: Reception
events.address: The Garden Pavilion, Palace Road, Civil Lines, Jaipur, Rajasthan - 302001
events.description: Good people make good moments better. Join us for an evening of celebration, dinner and dance as we begin our new journey together.

content.headline: Our Hearts Dance to One Tune
content.quote: Every love story is beautiful, but ours is my favourite song.
content.invitationMessage:
With the blessings of our families,
we cordially invite you to be a part
of our special day.

story.title: Music Class
story.description: She sang off-key; he played off-beat. Somehow, it became perfect harmony.

story.title: Growing Together
story.description: Backwater evenings, filter coffee debates and families dancing at every excuse.

story.title: Forever Begins
story.description: A night of music by the water — our forever starts with a dance. Join us!
